How-to that worked for rotating the OpenRouter key: 1) edit OPENROUTER_API_KEY in .env, 2) `docker compose restart librarian`, 3) run `bench/run.py --models deepseek-v4-flash --limit 1` to verify the new key is live.

Procedure that finally got the MCP streamable-HTTP server working behind nginx: in the /mcp location block set `proxy_buffering off;`, `proxy_http_version 1.1;` and `proxy_read_timeout 3600;`, then reload nginx and reconnect the client.
